account_welcome.subject: Welcome to Tikly
account_welcome.heading: Welcome, {name}!
account_welcome.intro: Your Tikly account is ready. You signed up as an {role}.

next.attendee: Discover events near you, buy tickets with Mobile Money or Orange Money, and keep your QR tickets in the app.
next.organizer: Create your first event, add ticket tiers and plan your budget, checklist, guests and agenda. Submit it for approval when you are ready.
next.provider: Add your business details and verification documents. Your services appear in listings once an administrator verifies your business.
next.exhibitor: Browse events with open display slots and book the space you need.
next.staff: Log in on the Tikly app in scanner mode to check tickets at the events you are assigned to.
next.admin: Review pending events and provider verifications from your dashboard.
